retrieved.text: If you suffer from melasma or sun damage try this before throwing your money away on expensive skin bleaching products that DON'T work. I've faithfully used Obaji products for 10 years.....it never faded the melasma, just kept it from darkening. My entire face was covered with melasma! After 2 weeks of using Donell AHA 20 I cannot believe the difference!! I have no more melasma on my forehead, nose, upper lip or chin. I can't wait to see what another 2 weeks of use does for my cheeks. My cheeks, arms and chest have lightened by at least 3 shades. I'm no longer wearing layers of foundation to hide my damaged skin. This stuff really works and works fast. It gives your skin a glow, can be worn under makeup without leaving skin oily yet somehow skin is super hydrated. I apply on clean skin in the morning and clean skin before bed. My skin has improved more in 2 weeks with this product than 10 years using expensive products from the dermatologist.

I’ve been dying my hair since I was 13 and am now WELL over that. I’ve used everything from kool-aid, Maniac Panic, Prevana etc in the constant search of finding a color that takes in my hair and is vivid enough to keep my attention and doesn’t fade so quickly I’m forced to maintain it more often than every few months. I have a lot of hair and it takes a few hours to dye. I found Atomic Pink about 9-10 years ago and fell in love! Saying it is bright really doesn’t do it justice. I can easily be seen in a crowd and it is very memorable. I refer so many to this dye I should have stock options lol. On me it does fade in a natural ombré fashion ending in a light cotton candy/baby pink after about 4-5 months. I bleach my roots only and only wash my hair with color safe products in cold water approximately 2-3 times a week. I receive daily comments and compliments. It’s a huge hit with the kids that love my “mermaid” hair. It also glows in black light for the first few weeks after you dye it. Word of caution. THIS DYE WILL STAIN EVERYTHING YOU TOUCH! Walls, showers, your skin etc. it will fade on your skin in a few days. Hands down worth every dollar!
retrieved.title: Only buy if you’re serious about real color. Worth every dollar!

retrieved.text:
This stuff is called "atomic" for a reason - it will Not leave your hair. This isn't the first time I've used this specific dye, and I know from experience that getting rid of it takes a lot of bleach, and a lot of patience. However, if you're not someone who likes to change your hair color often, I cannot recommend this stuff highly enough. It's the longest lasting dye on the market, I swear. If you don't mind roots, you can easily go months and months without redyeing. (I usually touch it up every 3 months, but that's just because of my roots. The color doesn't budge.) I've gone swimming in chlorine pools and the ocean, spent days under the midsummer sun, used really nasty hair spray, and washed my hair easily several dozen times without seeing it so much as lighten a little.
The only negative, and this I've only noticed this most recent dye job, is that it tends to never stop bleeding. My pillow, phone, nails - they all are still turning pink, nearly 2 months after I dyed my hair. I only wash my hair 1x/week, so if you wash more frequently you might see a sooner stop to the bleeding.

Note: my hair is curly, and very porous. Naturally dark brown, so I bleach before dyeing. I wash my hair 1x/week, and do not heat style. I use only silicone/sulfate free hair products
retrieved.title: longest lasting pink you can get
